source_refs.note: Exercise 13.3, Question 8 (a)-(c): minimum cost radius, minimum cost and C'(4) for C(r) = 8000 pi r^2 + 150000/r (book p.258). Key (PDF 311) prints it as number 14; (b) and (c) values corrected.

blocks.prompt: 8 (a) The cost \(C(r)\) to construct a cylindrical tank depends on the radius of the base, and is given by \(C(r) = 8000\pi r^2 + \dfrac{150000}{r}\), where the first term represents the cost of the base and the second term represents the cost of the walls. Find the radius that minimizes the construction cost.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh minimum (sab se kam) dhoondne ka sawal hai.
Humein woh radius \(r\) chahiye jis par cost sab se kam ho.
Plan: \(C'(r)\) nikalna, zero rakhna, \(r\) hal karna, aur \(C'\) ke sign se tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(C(r) = 8000\pi r^2 + 150000r^{-1}\), \(r > 0\).
Humein find karna hai: minimum cost wala radius.
Tareeqa: Wadi (sab se nichla point) par bhi slope zero hota hai: \(C'(r) = 0\). Phir sign se pakka karenge ke yeh minimum hai. Mantiq: radius bara karein to base mehnga, chhota karein to deewaren mehngi; beech mein kahin sab se sasta point hai.

Differentiate karein
\[C'(r) = 16000\pi r - \dfrac{150000}{r^2}\]
Kyun: \(8000\pi r^2 \to 16000\pi r\) (\(\pi\) sirf ek constant number hai). \(\frac{150000}{r} = 150000r^{-1} \to -150000r^{-2}\).
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{1}{r}\) ka derivative \(-\frac{1}{r^2}\) hai; minus bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

\(C'(r) = 0\) hal karein
\[16000\pi r^3 = 150000\]
\[r^3 = \dfrac{150000}{16000\pi} = \dfrac{75}{8\pi} \approx 2.984\]
\[r \approx 1.44\ \text{m}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \(r^2\) se guna kiya taake fraction khatam ho. Phir \(\frac{150000}{16000} = 9.375 = \frac{75}{8}\). Aakhir mein cube root: \(\sqrt[3]{2.984} \approx 1.4397\).

Minimum ki tasdeeq
\[C'(1) \approx -99735 < 0\]
\[C'(2) \approx 63031 > 0\]
Kyun: 1.44 se pehle slope negative (cost ghat rahi hai), baad mein positive (cost barh rahi hai). Ghat kar barhna ka matlab wadi, yani minimum.

blocks.prompt: 8 (b) The cost \(C(r)\) to construct a cylindrical tank depends on the radius of the base, and is given by \(C(r) = 8000\pi r^2 + \dfrac{150000}{r}\), where the first term represents the cost of the base and the second term represents the cost of the walls. Calculate the minimum cost.
blocks.explanation:
Humein minimum radius par cost nikalni hai.
Plan: part (a) ki shart se \(C\) ko saada karna, phir \(r \approx 1.4397\) rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(C(r) = 8000\pi r^2 + \dfrac{150000}{r}\); minimum par \(16000\pi r^3 = 150000\).
Humein find karna hai: \(C_{\min}\).
Tareeqa: Asal radius rakhna hai; zyada decimal places rakhein, kyunke \(r\) ko round karne se jawab thora badal jata hai.

Shart se saada karein
\[8000\pi r^2 = \dfrac{8000\pi r^3}{r} = \dfrac{75000}{r}\]
\[C_{\min} = \dfrac{75000}{r} + \dfrac{150000}{r} = \dfrac{225000}{r}\]
Kyun: Part (a) se \(16000\pi r^3 = 150000\), to aadha karne par \(8000\pi r^3 = 75000\). Dilchasp baat: minimum par deewaron ki cost base ki cost ki bilkul double hai.

\(r \approx 1.43971\) rakhein
\[C_{\min} \approx \dfrac{225000}{1.43971} \approx 156281.9\]
Kyun: Alag alag bhi dekh sakte hain: base \(\approx 52094\), deewaren \(\approx 104188\); jama \(\approx 156282\).
Dhyan dein: \(\pi\) ko 3.14 lene ya \(r\) ko jaldi round karne se aakhri digits badal jate hain; calculator ki \(\pi\) aur poora \(r\) istemal karein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key minimum cost Rs. 156250.57 deti hai, jo durust nahi. \(r = \sqrt[3]{75/(8\pi)} \approx 1.4397\) m se minimum cost taqreeban Rs. 156,281.9 aati hai (\(r = 1.44\) se bhi Rs. 156,281.9; sirf \(\pi \approx 3.14\) aur \(r = 1.44\) se taqreeban Rs. 156,255). Key ka number rounding ki ghalti se aaya hai.

blocks.prompt: 8 (c) The cost \(C(r)\) to construct a cylindrical tank depends on the radius of the base, and is given by \(C(r) = 8000\pi r^2 + \dfrac{150000}{r}\), where the first term represents the cost of the base and the second term represents the cost of the walls. Determine the rate of change of the cost at \(r = 4\) meters.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh rate of change ka sawal hai.
Humein \(C'(4)\) find karna hai.
Is se pata chalega ke 4 meter radius par radius thora sa barhane se cost kitni tezi se barhti hai.
Plan: part (a) wale \(C'(r)\) mein \(r = 4\) rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(C'(r) = 16000\pi r - \dfrac{150000}{r^2}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(C'(4)\).
Tareeqa: Seedha \(r = 4\) rakhna.

\(r = 4\) rakhein
\[C'(4) = 64000\pi - \dfrac{150000}{16}\]
\[\approx 201061.93 - 9375 = 191686.93\]
Kyun: \(16000 \times 4 = 64000\) aur \(4^2 = 16\), \(\frac{150000}{16} = 9375\). Jawab positive hai: \(r = 4\) m par radius ek meter barhane se cost taqreeban Rs. 191,687 barhti hai. Yeh samajh mein aata hai, kyunke 4 m minimum radius 1.44 m se kaafi bara hai, aur wahan base ki cost tezi se barhti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key ne Exercise 13.3 ke jawabat ko 1 se 8 ke bajaye 4, 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14 number diye hain. Is sawal ka jawab number 14 par chhapa hai: (a) \(r = 1.44\) m (sahi), (b) Rs. 156250.57 (upar wali correction dekhein), (c) 191686.6 units/m. Part (c) ki sahi value \(64000\pi - 9375 \approx 191686.9\) (rupay fi meter) hai; key ka 191686.6 rounding ki chhoti si ghalti hai.
